title: YouTube
summary: YouTube is an American video-sharing website headquartered in San Bruno, California and founded in 2005. On 27th October 2023, Rainbow S.p.A. launched the official YouTube channel for the Huntik series under the name Huntik Secrets & Seekers and the handle @HuntikOfficial. The channel began uploading full episodes of the series in HD quality, beginning with the first episode, "A Seeker Is Born".

sections.heading: History and Timeline
sections.wikitext:
Each episode was initially uploaded with multi-language audio features, with viewers able to select the audio language of their choice from English, French, German, Turkish, Spanish, Portuguese and Russian; however, not every episode has these multi-language audio features, with a lot of them having their audio exclusively in English and, later, French, German, Dutch, Italian and Portuguese.   

The channel later switched to uploading just episodes with the dub of just one language, alternating the uploads of the two Seasons between two languages, with the exception of English (first one to be uploaded) and Dutch, where both Seasons in the respective language were uploaded right after one another. The episode uploads were often separated by 2 days, but with several exceptions.  

On April 16, 2026 it was announced [https://www.advanced-television.com/2026/04/16/merzigo-partners-with-rainbow/ here] that Merzigo would partner with Rainbow to "expand the digital performance of more than 60 of Rainbow’s multi-language YouTube channels, including [...] Huntik: Secrets & Seekers". A few days later the channel saw a resurgence after more than 9 months without uploads, as well as a change in the style of the title and description of its videos, also now starting to upload Shorts. Ever since, the channel has uploaded one video every day at 15:00 UTC+0 (with the exception of the April 21st compilation video, being uploaded at around 17:00 UTC+0).

Below is a timeline of the languages and respective Seasons being uploaded to the channel.
* '''27th'''<ref>While the oldest video in the channel ("The Casterwill Client" in English) shows as being uploaded on the 30th of October 2023, the first video the channel uploaded was the first episode in English on the 27th, being deleted and reuploaded also on the 30th.</ref> '''October 2023''': Season 1 and Season 2 in English
* '''7th May 2024''': Season 1 in French
* '''2nd June 2024''': Season 1 in German
* '''16th August 2024''': Season 2 in French
* '''30th September 2024''': Season 2 in German
* '''15th November 2024''': Season 1 and Season 2 in Dutch
* '''14th February 2025''': Season 1 in Italian
* '''7th April 2025''': Season 1 in Portuguese
* '''23rd May 2025''': Season 2 in Italian
* '''22nd April 2025, 15:00 UTC+0''': reupload of Season 1 in Italian, 22 hours after uploading a 20 minute compilation of the first two episodes

sections.heading: Previous Channels
sections.text:
Huntik: Secrets & Seekers had previously made its official debut on the platform on the 6th February 2009, under the channel name HuntikGuggenheim. The channel, launched by Upper Deck, was designed to tie in with the Huntik Trading Card Game and consisted of a number of exclusive videos named Dante's Huntik TCG Tips in which Dante Vale gives his advice on the best tactics for using different cards. The channel's final video was uploaded on 5th June 2009, called Huntik Store Championships: The Professor Recruits You! in which the Professor explains information of latest Huntik TCG competition.

A number of official videos including the Huntik TCG Tutorial and numerous toy adverts were uploaded on Upper Deck's international YouTube channel in 2009. However, the channel was not solely dedicated to Huntik and featured videos from other properties as well. [Huntik TCG Tutorial]

On 15th May 2012, an official channel was created for Huntik by Rainbow, named HuntikSecretsSeekers. However, the channel only featured one upload, the episode Knight of the Willblade, which since been removed for unknown reasons. This was the last known official Huntik channel until October 2023 when Rainbow launched its brand new HuntikOfficial channel.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
*All the full episodes on the 2023 official channel were uploaded in a 16:9 aspect ratio, compared to the series' original 4:3 format.
*The Dutch dub of the episode "[[Coming of Age]]" has been made private, despite it initially being uploaded normally on 20th December 2024.
*The channel's most viewed video is the episode "A Seeker Is Born" with audio tracks available in multiple languages, uploaded on 30th October 2023. It stands at over 1 million views as of April 2026.
*The first episode to be uploaded to the channel was the first episode of the show, "[[A Seeker Is Born]]", but it was deleted days later and re-uploaded with multi-language audio features. This means that the second episode, "[[The Casterwill Client]]", appears as the very first video on the channel.

full_text:
YouTube is an American video-sharing website headquartered in San Bruno, California and founded in 2005. On 27th October 2023, Rainbow S.p.A. launched the official YouTube channel for the Huntik series under the name Huntik Secrets & Seekers and the handle @HuntikOfficial. The channel began uploading full episodes of the series in HD quality, beginning with the first episode, "A Seeker Is Born".

History and Timeline

Each episode was initially uploaded with multi-language audio features, with viewers able to select the audio language of their choice from English, French, German, Turkish, Spanish, Portuguese and Russian; however, not every episode has these multi-language audio features, with a lot of them having their audio exclusively in English and, later, French, German, Dutch, Italian and Portuguese.

The channel later switched to uploading just episodes with the dub of just one language, alternating the uploads of the two Seasons between two languages, with the exception of English (first one to be uploaded) and Dutch, where both Seasons in the respective language were uploaded right after one another. The episode uploads were often separated by 2 days, but with several exceptions.

On April 16, 2026 it was announced here that Merzigo would partner with Rainbow to "expand the digital performance of more than 60 of Rainbow’s multi-language YouTube channels, including [...] Huntik: Secrets & Seekers". A few days later the channel saw a resurgence after more than 9 months without uploads, as well as a change in the style of the title and description of its videos, also now starting to upload Shorts. Ever since, the channel has uploaded one video every day at 15:00 UTC+0 (with the exception of the April 21st compilation video, being uploaded at around 17:00 UTC+0).

Below is a timeline of the languages and respective Seasons being uploaded to the channel.
• 27th [Reference: While the oldest video in the channel ("The Casterwill Client" in English) shows as being uploaded on the 30th of October 2023, the first video the channel uploaded was the first episode in English on the 27th, being deleted and reuploaded also on the 30th.] October 2023: Season 1 and Season 2 in English

Previous Channels

Huntik: Secrets & Seekers had previously made its official debut on the platform on the 6th February 2009, under the channel name HuntikGuggenheim. The channel, launched by Upper Deck, was designed to tie in with the Huntik Trading Card Game and consisted of a number of exclusive videos named Dante's Huntik TCG Tips in which Dante Vale gives his advice on the best tactics for using different cards. The channel's final video was uploaded on 5th June 2009, called Huntik Store Championships: The Professor Recruits You! in which the Professor explains information of latest Huntik TCG competition.

A number of official videos including the Huntik TCG Tutorial and numerous toy adverts were uploaded on Upper Deck's international YouTube channel in 2009. However, the channel was not solely dedicated to Huntik and featured videos from other properties as well. [Huntik TCG Tutorial]

On 15th May 2012, an official channel was created for Huntik by Rainbow, named HuntikSecretsSeekers. However, the channel only featured one upload, the episode Knight of the Willblade, which since been removed for unknown reasons. This was the last known official Huntik channel until October 2023 when Rainbow launched its brand new HuntikOfficial channel.

Trivia

• All the full episodes on the 2023 official channel were uploaded in a 16:9 aspect ratio, compared to the series' original 4:3 format.
• The Dutch dub of the episode "Coming of Age" has been made private, despite it initially being uploaded normally on 20th December 2024.
• The channel's most viewed video is the episode "A Seeker Is Born" with audio tracks available in multiple languages, uploaded on 30th October 2023. It stands at over 1 million views as of April 2026.
• The first episode to be uploaded to the channel was the first episode of the show, "A Seeker Is Born", but it was deleted days later and re-uploaded with multi-language audio features. This means that the second episode, "The Casterwill Client", appears as the very first video on the channel.
